title: Made a cozy stargazing idle game (with a lot of AI help). Would love your honest feedback
author: Interesting_Lead1420

comments.author: RecordingTechnical86
comments.body: Actually a very satisfying and enjoyable game. The changing pitch in the collection sound is really selling. ;aybe introduce a rising combo if you stay in that zone. Rising sound = slightly rising points per clicked star. I really like star connecting and finding new zodiacs. I found the crafting button and all the buttons in the upper right a bit small. But dont know where they could ft, might be fine.

replies.author: Interesting_Lead1420
replies.body:
Thank you, this made my day. That rising pitch is one of my favorite details so I'm really glad it landed.
And good news: that's actually already how it works. The longer you keep catching in that zone the more the combo builds, and the rising sound is tied to rising points per star, exactly like you described. So you found it without me telling you, which honestly means it's doing its job. There's also a little payoff spike if you keep a streak going.
Really glad the star connecting and finding the zodiacs clicked too, that's the heart of it. And the small buttons up top have come up from a few people now, so that's a real one I need to sort out.
